stages.request: Our accountants load `audit_journal.csv` into their spreadsheet at month end, and its money columns arrive in whole cents (`41325` for 413.25), so they divide every figure by hand. Have the night audit write the journal's money columns in the `0.00` format instead, like `413.25`.

quiet.path: The journal module's docstring says the revenue report reads the file back; following who opens audit_journal.csv leads to revenue_summary, which turns each money column into cents with int().

stages.request: Contractors on long jobs keep asking us for six-week stays, and anything over 30 nights is refused. Raise the default of the `max_stay_nights` setting to `45`.

Tax on the folio comes out a cent short on some charges. A 12.50 minibar charge shows 0.90 tax, but 7.25% of 12.50 is 0.90625 and the county's table says 0.91; a 150.00 room night shows 17.62 where the table says 17.63. The county rounds the tax on each charge `half-up` to the cent, and we are cutting the fraction off. Please fix it.

quiet.path: Looking for every place lodging tax is worked out (TAX_RATES is read in two modules) finds quote(), which taxes each night itself, truncating, with a comment saying it does so the way the night audit posts it; the reference says a quote's tax equals the tax posted.

stages.request: Our new accounting package reads the folio export and wants nightly room charges under the code `ROOM`; it rejects `RM`. Make `ROOM` the code for room charges on the folio in place of `RM`. The desk staff are used to typing `RM` with the `post` command, so the command line should keep accepting `RM` and record it as `ROOM`.

quiet.path: Searching for the code string "RM" finds the printed folio's SECTIONS registry, which files charges under Accommodation by code and sends any code it does not list to Extras.

stages.request: When an agent tries to check a guest into a room housekeeping hasn't finished, `check_in` refuses with `Room 102 is not available` and the command line prints the same, so the agent has to go and find out why. Make the message give the room's housekeeping status: `Room {room} is not ready: {status}`, for example `Room 102 is not ready: dirty`.

`day_statistics()` returns occupancy as a fraction, and `report occupancy --format json` on the command line passes the same number on to our owner's dashboard, which expects a percentage. Return occupancy as a percentage rounded to two decimal places, so two of five rooms sold reads `40.0` instead of `0.4`, and one of three reads `33.33`.

quiet.path: run_audit stores day_statistics() in AuditResult.statistics; following that field to its reader finds the audit report, which multiplies the occupancy value by 100 before printing it as a percentage.

stages.request: The state file keeps every cancelled reservation forever and is getting slow to load. Have the night audit remove a cancelled reservation once its departure date is more than `cancelled_retention_days` days before the business date the audit is closing. Add `cancelled_retention_days` as a setting with a default of `30`.

quiet.path: Asking what relies on hotel.reservations only ever growing finds _next_id in booking, which numbers a new reservation len(hotel.reservations) + 1; the reference promises numbers are never reused, so removing records makes it hand out a number already in use.

stages.request: Our late check-out charge goes up next month. Change the default of the `late_checkout_fee` setting from 25.00 to `40.00`.
